Subject: Greenleaf Pharma - Security questionnaire & next steps

Hi Sara / Brian,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about Greenleaf's planned rollout and dataflows. Per our call, next steps to kick off the security review:

- We'd like to start with your vendor security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ or your custom spreadsheet). If you can share the latest version we can begin filling the relevant sections.
- Quick answers that will unblock us: do you require a SOC 2 Type II report, and if so do you need the latest SOC 2 or an in-flight report?
- Please confirm if HIPAA business associate agreements / PHI handling requirements apply to the integration.
- Any required data residency or customer-managed key (KMS/HSM) constraints we should know about?

I've attached our SIG template (Redwood_SIG_Template.xlsx) which often helps accelerate the process — we can map fields 1:1. I'll loop in Logan (copied) for the technical Qs he may want to answer directly.

Suggested timeline: we can return a completed SIG/CAIQ draft within ~7-10 business days after we receive your questionnaire + any clarifying notes. If you prefer, we can do a short follow-up call between security teams to walk through any tricky items.

Thanks — I'll wait for the file and any preferred point of contact on your side for security or procurement.

Best,

Hi Camila,

Thanks — appreciate the clear recap. Attaching our standard security questionnaire (GLP_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx). A few quick clarifications from our side before we hand this off to Security/Procurement: 

1) SOC 2: we require either a current SOC 2 Type II report or, if in progress, a SOC 2 Type II in-flight letter plus a timeline to completion. Can you confirm Redwood's current status?
2) HIPAA: our use case will touch PHI, so we need a signed BAA. Do you have a standard BAA or is this handled via our legal team later in contracting?
3) Pen test / vulnerability assessment: do you provide a recent pen test summary or remediation report? Is Red team access or an on-site pen test required?
4) Encryption: we have a few questions in the questionnaire about KMS provider and customer-managed keys — can Logan address those?

Procurement (Brian) is CC'd to coordinate timelines. We'd like to have an initial pass back within two weeks if possible.

Thanks,
Sara Jenkins

Hi Sara / Brian —

Received, thank you. Quick answers while Logan weighs in:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report (most recent fiscal period ended 2026-10). We can share the report under NDA and can provide an in-flight attestation if needed for specific controls.
- BAA: Redwood has a standard BAA we use for PHI customers — happy to share a template and route legal if Greenleaf prefers your redlines.
- Pen test: we have a recent third-party penetration test summary (Q3 2026) and remediation notes; we typically provide an executive summary to prospects and can arrange an on-demand deeper engagement for enterprise customers.

Logan — can you take the questionnaire and flag any questions that need a short technical write-up or if you want a call with Greenleaf SecOps? I've put the Drive link for the questionnaire here so we can collaborate: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Greenleaf-SIG

Sara/Brian — I'll aim to have the first pass back within 7-10 business days after Logan's review. If you prefer a call to triage the questionnaire, let me know a time and we'll set it up.

Subject: Re: Greenleaf Pharma - Security questionnaire & next steps

Hi Sara — thanks for sending the questionnaire. I started a pass and wanted to call out a few clarifying Qs that would speed our response: 

- Encryption/KMS: are you asking for customer-managed keys (BYOK) for all persisted data, or only for specific datasets? We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and GCP KMS; for dedicated private deployments we can integrate HSMs.
- Data residency: are there specific country/region constraints per customer dataset or org-wide? We can serve from us-east-1 or eu-west-1 clusters; on-prem options are also available for regulated workloads.
- Scoped access for pen tests: if Greenleaf wants us to coordinate a pen test, please confirm expected scope (prod vs staging) and whether you require vendor access or a joint engagement.
- Proofs: we'll attach the SOC 2 Type II PDF and the pen test executive summary under NDA. For the questionnaire, would you prefer we paste answers inline or provide a completed spreadsheet? We can do either — inline answers are faster for a first pass.

Plan: I'll complete an inline pass and highlight any items that need legal/architecture input. Expect the initial draft by end of next week (EOD 2027-02-23). If Greenleaf prefers a quick 30-min triage between security teams earlier, I'm available Wed/Thu afternoon PST.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
